title.zh: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto
title.en: Everyone wants SCOTUS to take up prediction markets: State of Crypto

current_state.zh: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.
current_state.en: A coalition including former officials, the NFL, 39 states and 145 tribal nations filed amicus briefs urging the Supreme Court to weigh in on whether sports-based prediction market contracts are swaps, while the CFTC issued two proposals — one an interim final rule already in effect — setting out its own position on the question.
